inputs.code:
// Flatten properties into the row shape the contract promises. A field never set
// on a record is MISSING, not null - strings default to '' so the UI never renders
// "null", and numbers/dates stay null so "no salary" is distinguishable from zero.
def sv = { m, k -> (m != null && m[k] != null) ? m[k].toString() : '' }
def nv = { m, k -> (m != null && m[k] != null) ? m[k] : null }

// ONE bulk fetch of Currency, joined here. Never one call per row.
def codes = [:]
def cur = []
if (currencyRows != null) currencyRows.each { c ->
    def cp = c.properties
    def code = sv(cp, 'code')
    codes[String.valueOf(c.id)] = code
    cur << [currencyId: String.valueOf(c.id), code: code, name: sv(cp, 'name')]
}

def out = []
if (rows != null) rows.each { r ->
    def p = r.properties
    out << [payeeId: String.valueOf(r.id),
            employeeId: sv(p, 'employeeId'),
            firstName: sv(p, 'firstName'),
            lastName: sv(p, 'lastName'),
            email: sv(p, 'email'),
            userId: sv(p, 'userId'),
            currencyId: sv(p, 'currencyId'),
            personalCurrencyId: sv(p, 'personalCurrencyId'),
            hireDate: nv(p, 'hireDate'),
            terminationDate: nv(p, 'terminationDate'),
            status: sv(p, 'status'),
            region: sv(p, 'region'),
            businessGroup: sv(p, 'businessGroup'),
            team: sv(p, 'team'),
            personalTarget: nv(p, 'personalTarget'),
            salary: nv(p, 'salary'),
            name: sv(p, 'name'),
            currencyCode: codes.get(sv(p, 'currencyId')) ?: '',
            personalCurrencyCode: codes.get(sv(p, 'personalCurrencyId')) ?: '']
}
int tot = (total == null) ? out.size() : (total as int)
return [people: out, currencies: cur, total: tot,
        hasMore: (pageOffset + out.size()) < tot,
        message: out.isEmpty() ? 'No people matched.' : (out.size() + ' person(s).')]
